energyStars.label: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating
energyStars.helpOff: Each send will set Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five)
energyStars.helpOn: Each send sets Rating in rekordbox from your tracks' energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five). Tracks with no energy keep their stars.
energyStars.offNote: Stars in rekordbox stay as last sent. Your Library's rating follows rekordbox again.
energyStars.confirmTitle: Send energy to rekordbox as Rating?
energyStars.changes_zero: No stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_one: {{count, number}} track's stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_other: {{count, number}} tracks' stars in rekordbox would change (export read {{when}})
energyStars.noRead: Can't count yet (no rekordbox export read). The send checklist shows the number before anything is written.
energyStars.confirmDetail: Tracks with no energy keep their stars. If you change a Rating in rekordbox later, you'll choose which to keep in Review under Conflicts. Turning this off later stops the sending, but stars already sent stay in rekordbox.
energyStars.error: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
energyStars.countError: Couldn't count the tracks. Try again.

error.notOurs: This file isn't a tracklist-pro bundle.
error.tooLarge: This bundle is too large to open.
error.damaged: This bundle is damaged, so it can't be used.
error.newer: This bundle was made by a newer version of tracklist-pro. Update the app, then try again.
error.nothingStaged: There's no bundle ready to import. Choose the file again.
error.backupNotFound: That backup is no longer there.
